profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman

positions.title: Hardware Engineering Intern
positions.description:
●Performed SOLT/TRL calibrations using the PNA Microwave Network Analyzer to measure S-Parameters for
amplifiers, attenuators, switches, filters, and other microwave components on a silicon wafer
● Set up and calibrated a test bench using a PNA, probe station, power meter, signal generator, coupler, power
supplies, and power sensors to obtain gain compression measurements with LabVIEW
● Contributed to coding a MATLAB GUI that would automatically calibrate, run tests, and collect data for gain
compression measurements over multiple biasing points
● Developed a MATLAB code that can graph and manipulate collected data of multiple file types
